svg.title: The Five-Move Demo
svg.desc: A RoboLore instructional graphic showing five calls to driveDistance and turnDegrees composed into a path that returns to the corner.

path.aria-label: The robot drives to the corner, turns, drives up, spins around, and retraces the same 20 cm path.
Legs 3 and 5 cover the same 20 cm of floor.
The robot drives up, spins 180° in place, and drives back down its own path.
They are separated in the diagram only for clarity; on the desk, the two paths lie directly on top of each other.
